dimensions.description: Correctly identifies all six below-threshold transactions (T1-001 through T1-006) as one aggregation pattern, states the correct aggregate total (GBP 55,200), and does not conclude 'no findings' merely because each transaction is individually compliant.

Explicitly reviews and clears T1-007 and T1-008 with a stated, specific reason for each, rather than silently omitting them or including them because they share superficial similarity (destination or being under-threshold) with the real pattern.
Correctly names the typology (structuring / smurfing: splitting a large transfer into below-threshold transactions to avoid a reporting requirement).
Every factual claim about a transaction, account, or amount cites a txn_id that exists in data/structuring_transfers.csv. Claims are not made without supporting evidence.
Does not invent transaction IDs, account names, or amounts that are not present in data/structuring_transfers.csv.
Citations are specific and checkable (exact txn_ids, not vague references like 'several transfers'). A reader could verify every claim against the source file without guessing.

The report is well-organised, uses cautious compliance-appropriate language (no unhedged accusations of criminality), and clearly separates observed facts (amounts, timing, destination) from interpretation (that this is consistent with deliberate structuring).
